title: Articulating
description: The originating morphism of the predicate category — α : (name relationlessness) ⇝ φ*. Articulating takes the name 'relationlessness' and asserts the originating cell φ* = (X, p*, R) with positive evidence v(p*)(X, R) >_k ⊥. One-way: there is no inverse from φ* back to an un-named state. The act records (a) the input name, (b) the asserted cell-record at φ* with a bilattice-value strictly above knowledge-bottom, and (c) the transaction-id at which the articulation occurred. Strict-above-bottom is a runtime invariant: the schema requires the value be a bilattice-value; the script checks the value is not at the bilattice's knowledge-bottom.

name.description: The name being articulated. Only 'relationlessness' is admissible — articulating is specifically the originating morphism that asserts φ*; other names would be different morphisms.

asserted-record.description: The cell-record this articulation asserts: cell = relationlessness (φ*), value = bilattice-value > ⊥ in knowledge order (runtime-checked against the bilattice's knowledge-meet table), t = transaction-id of the articulation.
